summary: Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacifico filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing execution of bank credit facilities totaling Ps. 8,000 million. Proceeds will be drawn gradually, with Ps. 4,258 million earmarked to repay GAP22L and GAP21-V debt certificates maturing September 21 and October 9, 2026, and Ps. 3,742 million funding Master Development Program capex. Lenders include Santander, BBVA, HSBC, J.P. Morgan and Scotiabank; terms run 6-12 months, some extendable six months, at floating TIIE plus a 45bp weighted-average spread. This is a routine financing, not a special situation; monitor refinancing rates and covenant terms.
